## Travel: Consolidated Itinerary (2 of 2)

**Flow:** Schedule Trigger (daily) → Google Sheets: Read Rows → Group & Build Itinerary → Slack.

This is the SCHEDULED half — it reads every row from the same Sheet that "Travel: Log Booking" writes to, groups rows by tripTag, keeps only trips whose latest leg hasn't fully passed yet, sorts each trip's legs chronologically, and posts one consolidated Slack message covering every currently-upcoming trip.

**Read-only and side-effect-free** — this workflow never writes anything back to the Sheet or creates duplicate entries, so it's safe to run as often as you like.

**Known limitation:** each leg's time is displayed exactly as extracted (its own local time) rather than converted to one shared timezone — a Tokyo arrival time and a Manila departure time are each shown as their own local clock time, not converted into each other. This avoids a worse bug (silently shifting times by the wrong offset), at the cost of not showing "how many hours apart" two legs' times really are.

**Before activating:**
1. Credentials: Google Sheets, Slack.
2. `Google Sheets: Read Rows`: point at the EXACT same spreadsheet + sheet as "Travel: Log Booking" uses. This is a Get Row(s)-style read operation — the exact field name may need reselecting after import.
3. `Slack: Send Itinerary`: confirm channel (can be the same channel as the logging workflow, or a separate one just for itinerary digests).
4. Schedule Trigger defaults to 7am daily (Asia/Manila) — adjust as you like; running daily is harmless since this workflow only reads and never writes.

**IMPORTANT when reimporting after any future fix:** select all nodes (Ctrl+A) and delete them BEFORE importing, or n8n will auto-rename nodes with a trailing "1" and break every cross-node reference.
